description: Traffic Accidents Cases by Severity is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. Number of traffic accident cases by severity (death, severe injury, slight injury, and physical damage), 2008-2023. Physical damage was reported through 2016 only. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are traffic accidents, road safety. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-07-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
